sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 17 February 2025, pitch SYN-SYNCP000029-P1 was put before Summit Wellness Center 029 on behalf of MERCK & COMPANY.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a Band 3 rebate of 4 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a Pneumococcal preferred-position minimum of 55 per cent in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer turned the terms down.
